decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already captures the newly added direct-on-NFT display surface; the referral-code basis, lifetime, sharing methods, and resale behavior remain unchanged.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already captures the newly specified transfer of active prize tickets to the buyer.
The existing message-146 MODIFY captures that the founder share is net of applicable fiat fees; the $15 price, $4 share, commission, and prize-pool destinations remain unchanged.

The candidate's message-146 INTRODUCE already establishes the no-referral condition, $5 commission, and random existing-holder recipient; the ticket clause is outside this commission-only Requirement.
The FAQ continues to identify the NFT's mint number as the metadata referral code and does not change the existing ticket-counter or permanent-badge metadata requirements.
The source repeats the existing immediate automatic $5 wallet payout for a successful code-used mint without changing its trigger, recipient, amount, destination, timing, or limit.
Transak and the supported cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay methods were already established before message 146; the source does not change the provider or conversion flow.
The source restates the existing five $500 prizes at approximately 500 counted mint and secondary sales and does not change the Small Block mechanism.
Chainlink VRF, on-chain execution, provable fairness, and Basescan verification were already established and are only restated.
The source continues to describe the collection as an unlimited-mint NFT ebook and does not alter the collection model.
The source restates the existing five $10,000 prizes every approximately 50,000 mint and secondary sales without changing the Big Block mechanism.
The source repeats the existing referral milestones and on-chain badge recording; changes to descriptive future badge utility do not alter badge-award accuracy.
